name: TIE/dg starfighter
description: The TIE/dg starfighter, also known as the TIE Dagger or the Sith TIE fighter, was a type of Sith Eternal-affiliated TIE fighter series starship that was forged in secret by forces under the command of the reborn Darth Sidious, along with the Xyston-class Star Destroyer, the AAL-2100/9.5 atmospheric assault lander, and other new technology created by the Sith cult.
